affected_predicate.description: Every toot displayed in the Mastodon search results for the #dogs hashtag is favorited.

competing_trace_defects.description: Beginning at step 20, the agent repeatedly clicks the favorite control on the same visible Golden Retriever post, alternately favoriting and unfavoriting it while continuing to describe successive posts and progress. This independently observable loop prevents reliable monotonic completion of the favorite-all subgoal.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent explicitly accepts the false claim that the second visible post was favorited and scrolls onward, although the source transition had changed that post's star from filled blue to outlined. The trace never visibly returns to correct that specific removed favorite. Subsequent actions continue under asserted favorite-count progress, and the last supplied view still visibly includes an outlined star on another #dogs result, so the predicate that all displayed #dogs toots are favorited is observably unsatisfied without relying on any hidden verdict.

summary: The frozen strict-MHR chain visibly preserves an unfavorited #dogs post through false completion at step 9, with no later correction of that post. An additional repeated toggle loop is independently observable later in the trajectory, and the final supplied view still shows a visible #dogs result with an outlined favorite control.
